title: 7. A ultrapassagem das defesas emocionais em mulheres fechadas à aproximação e ao contato

queries.text: "cara-de-pau" (lit. "wooden face") means brazen nerve, shamelessness. Rendered "having a brazen face". Alternatives: "brass neck" (British), "having the nerve", "a poker face" (wrong nuance).

translator_notes.text: Nelson Rodrigues (1912–1980), Brazilian playwright and columnist known for provocative aphorisms; little known to English-language readers.
